overall_assessment: Section splitting works well for NTNU: headings are mapped correctly, sub-headings in learning outcomes survive, and ordinary plans come out clean. The main weaknesses are plans whose text is only a pointer to an English page (sections hold 'See English version.'), and arbeidskrav text filed under assessment or teaching_methods when it sits under 'Mer om vurdering' or 'Læringsformer og aktiviteter'.

findings.description: Where the Norwegian page only points to the English version, course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods (and in IMT4127 also prerequisites and reading_list) are emitted as rows whose whole text is a pointer, identical across sections. The real content is not captured. These are empty placeholders, not content, and the same text is repeated in 3 to 5 sections. In IMT4127 the prerequisites row holds the pointer twice. Pre-pass flags short and dup_in_course are real here.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Pointer text ('See English version', 'se engelsk beskrivelse', 'Samme som NORD2001') is not recognised as a placeholder in .clean_sections() or sectionize(). The English-language page of the same course is not used as a source.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() drop section text matching a pointer regex (^(see|se|samme som)\b.{0,40}(english|engelsk|NORD\d+)...$) so no row is emitted. Longer term, take the section text from the other-language page (the source_course_id for the English version) when the Norwegian one is only a pointer.

findings.evidence: Obligatoriske arbeidskrav vurderes som godkjent/ikke godkjent.
findings.description: Under 'Mer om vurdering' the plan lists the three obligatory arbeidskrav (approve/fail gates) in full. The codebook puts these in coursework_requirements, but they are all in assessment, while coursework_requirements holds only the stub 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav iht. emnebeskrivelsen'. The real requirements are in the wrong section and the right section is nearly empty.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Mer om vurdering' heading maps to assessment as a whole and the block is not split by content. Arbeidskrav paragraphs inside it are not routed to coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() or sectionize(), move paragraphs of the assessment block that start with 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' / 'Arbeidskrav' to coursework_requirements. Alternatively add a sub-block rule for paragraphs beginning with these words.

findings.evidence: Obligatoriske arbeidskrav: Inntil 3 skriftlige og/eller muntlige arbeidskrav
findings.description: Free text under 'Læringsformer og aktiviteter' contains arbeidskrav rules (NORX2001, duplicating the coursework_requirements row) and a 'Vurderingsform: Deltakelse, paper.' line (SARB8002). These belong to coursework_requirements and assessment. The pre-pass leak flags are real, though the effect is small.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The plan puts these sentences inside the teaching block without their own heading. The splitter cuts only at headings.
findings.suggested_fix: Add paragraph-level routing in .clean_sections(): move lines in teaching_methods that start with 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' to coursework_requirements, and lines starting with 'Vurderingsform' to assessment. Or accept as low-priority noise and document it.

findings.evidence: 15 plasser er forbeholdt søkere til master i spesialpedagogikk.
findings.description: 'Forkunnskapskrav' text that is admission and seat allocation (LGU14008: reserved places, PPU4725: 'Opptak til femårig lærerutdanning og beståtte eksamener i henhold til forskrift') is filed as prerequisites. The knowledge prerequisite and the admission rule are mixed. The rule is that admission text is not a prerequisite. The pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag on PPU4725 is partly right.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Forkunnskapskrav' is mapped wholesale to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R. NTNU uses it for both admission and knowledge requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop sentences in prerequisites matching admission patterns ('plasser er forbeholdt', '^Opptak til', 'Krever opptak'). Document it in course_plan_spec.md if the rule is accepted.

findings.evidence: Disse studentene må ta kontakt med instituttet før oppmeldingsfristen 9.juli.
findings.description: Assessment holds exam logistics and administrative notices next to the assessment design: aids ('Hjelpemidler til eksamen: Godkjent kalkulator...'), registration deadlines, admission remarks and postponed-exam arrangements. The structured exam table is appended on every course ('Vurderingsordning:', 'Karakter:', 'Vekting ... Hjelpemiddel Kode ... Varighet'). Weights and form are legitimate assessment design, but aid codes and deadlines are logistics. This is consistent across NTNU, not a one-off.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Mer om vurdering' and 'Eksamen' both map to assessment and are concatenated without filtering. Calculator and deadline paragraphs are not removed.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop assessment lines matching 'Hjelpemidler til eksamen', 'oppmeldingsfrist', 'Eksamenssystem' and calculator model lists, per course_plan_spec.md. Keep Vekting, Varighet and form.

findings.evidence: Tar forbehold om endringer i faglig innhold.
findings.description: The closing paragraphs 'Anvendelser av statistiske metoder ...', 'Valg av statistisk programvare kunngjøres ved semesterstart.' and 'Tar forbehold om endringer i faglig innhold.' occur twice in course_content. The duplication is already in the source plan, but the extractor passes it on, and the last paragraph is a disclaimer, not content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page repeats the block and no line-level de-duplication is done within a section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exact-duplicate paragraph removal within a section in .clean_sections(). Optionally add the 'Tar forbehold om endringer' disclaimer to the boilerplate list.
